I tested 3 note apps for 2 weeks in October and kept one of them.

1. Notion: great for docs, slow to open on my phone, about 4.5 seconds.
2. Obsidian: fast, local, and the plugin I needed took me 20 minutes to set up.
3. Apple Notes: instant, but I couldn't link notes the way I wanted.

I kept Obsidian because the files are plain markdown on my own disk, which means I can grep them. The work I do in it is mostly drafts and build logs — nothing fancy.

My setup notes are at https://example.com/leverage-robust-notes if you want to copy them.

Which app would you have kept, and why?
